body_markdown:
Our CEO Kristian Sørensen spoke at Arctic Shipping Investor Day on 22 October 2026, sharing insights into the LPG shipping market and BW LPG’s strategic positioning.


His presentation explored how shifting trade flows, rising North American LPG exports and longer voyages are driving shipping demand and supporting freight rates. He also highlighted how BW LPG’s combined shipping and trading business, balanced chartering strategy and disciplined asset management position the company to navigate changing market conditions.


Click here to access the[PowerPoint](https://www.bwlpg.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/BW-LPG-Arctic-Shipping-Investor-Day-22.10.26.pdf) deck.
